content: Pico W OTA options: (1) picowota (usedbytes) — git submodule, TCP port 4242 bootloader, picowota_reboot(true) from app to enter OTA mode; WiFi firmware duplicated in bootloader+app binary (~300-400KB each). Best for: dedicated OTA slot. (2) Direct HTTP download: fetch .uf2 in 10KB chunks (RAM limit), extract payload blocks, flash_range_erase + flash_range_program, reboot. Best for simplicity with Mongoose already present. (3) pico-ota (wedsamuel1230 on GitHub) — single/dual core patterns. Recommendation: for Phase 17 skeleton, use picowota submodule (safer, handles CRC check) with OTA trigger via WS 'command':'ota' message that calls picowota_reboot(true).
